camera.reason: 32MP f/1.8 PDAF main camera, the highest resolution in the bracket, no OIS.

performance.reason: Unisoc T612 with 4GB RAM handles basic apps but struggles with games.

battery.reason: 5,000mAh lasts a full day, but 10W charging is slow to refill.

display.reason: 6.74 inch HD+ LCD at 90Hz with 560 nits peak.

build.reason: IP64 dust tight rating and a die cast aluminium inner chassis in a plastic shell.

software.reason: Full Android 14 realme UI, but no published OS update commitment.

value.reason: Best build and camera in the bracket, but at 25,000 it is the priciest with 10W charging.

availability.reason: Out of stock at PriceOye today; listed on realme Pakistan's site with official warranty.

notes: Prices are WhatMobile official prices (24,999 and 28,999). PriceOye lists the 4GB 64GB at 24,499 and the 4GB 128GB at 26,799, both out of stock on 2026-10-10. realme lists a 48 month fluency claim, which is not an update policy, so osUpdates and securityYears are 0.
